title: One Tsar Bomba-class warhead over New York, ring by ring

strikes.target_name: Lower Manhattan, same ground zero (scale comparison only)
strikes.weapon: Top of the Russian missile warhead range, SS-18 class (500 to 800 kt)
strikes.notes: Comparison drawn on the same map, not a second attack. 800 kt is the top of the FAS range for SS-18 warheads, research.md A22; US W88 is about 450 kt by published estimates (A21), not used.

strikes.launch_name: Release point over the North Atlantic (location simulated)
strikes.weapon: Tsar Bomba-class 50 Mt bomb (never deployed, A12; delivery simulated)
strikes.notes: Yield: Soviet figure for the 1961 test, research.md A1 (published range 50 to 58, A2). Burst height not an engine input: the engine places an airburst at the height that maximises the 5 psi ring; the real test burst at about 4,000 m (A1). Attacker not named. Bomb never deployed, A12.

model: Glasstone and Dolan scaling calibrated to NUKEMAP Hiroshima figures; flight times fitted to published ranges; all values are estimates for a labelled simulation.
